description_en: Obtain task execution details by instance ID and job ID.
description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID获取任务执行详情
name: GetAiOutboundTaskExecDetail

parameters.help_en:
The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.

You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The job ID.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html API and check the Data field in the response, or invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html API and check the TaskId field in the response
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html接口，查看返回参数中的**Data**，或者调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html接口，查看返回参数中的**TaskId**
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
Job execution status for a single phone number. Valid values:

1: Pending call.
2: Calling.
3: Completed.
4: Stopped.
5: Pending retry
parameters.help_zh:
单条号码任务执行状态。取值：

1：待呼叫。
2：呼叫中。
3：已完成。
4：已终止。
5：待重呼
parameters.name: case_status

parameters.help_en: Start time of phone number import. Format: UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 号码导入起始时间。时间戳格式，单位戳：毫秒
parameters.name: create_time_start

parameters.help_en: End time of phone number import. Format: UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 号码导入结束时间。时间戳格式，单位戳：毫秒
parameters.name: create_time_end

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。取值大于0，默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Page size. The value must be greater than 0. Default Value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。取值大于0，默认值：20
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: Activity ID associated with this outbound call
parameters.name: case_id
